description: This file defines the 'Transfer' class in the 'Aws\S3' namespace, responsible for managing file transfers between local filesystem and Amazon S3, supporting upload and download operations with options for concurrency, multipart uploads, and debugging.

classes.name: Transfer
classes.description: Class for transferring files to and from Amazon S3, supporting both upload and download, with options for concurrency, multipart uploads, and debugging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the transfer with client, source, destination, and options, validating schemes and setting parameters.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Creates or returns an existing promise representing the ongoing transfer operation.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Executes the transfer synchronously by waiting for the promise to resolve.
